state.issueAcceptance:
Parent: #1022. Baseline observation: CORE-01 (P1). Depends on delivered #1028/#1029.

Observable gap: fourteen aggregate guards serialize statically typed DomainEvent as `{}`. Several other nominal payload budgets exceed the pinned Fitz operation limit. FitzEventStore serializes after opening an append session and can begin a batch before finding an oversized later event. KV writes need real route/key/value overhead.

Allowed scope: shared concrete generated event sizing; corrections to audited event guards/budgets; shared whole-attributed-batch event-store preflight and notifier forwarding; KV write framing guard; transport-independent validation mapping; application composition; focused regressions and serializer/SDK boundary proof; remediation ledger updates. No aggregate boundary split, business-policy change, new lifetime cap, unrelated identity contract, deployment or environment reset.

Acceptance:
- Focused RED before implementation, starting with oversized concrete incident event admitted by individually valid fields.
- Preflight all actual serialized envelopes before any append session opens; enforce `envelope bytes + UTF8(route) + 26 <= 65535` and KV `value + route + key + 20 <= 65535`.
- Reject oversized later events before any batch append, including large attribution, Unicode and serializer failures; preserve exact valid-boundary batches, read paths, cancellation and event notifications.
- Oversize rejection maps to ordinary nontransient request validation for result/no-result dispatch without bypassing authorization.
- Replace the fourteen base-event calls; correct additional nominal budgets; use concrete generated metadata with coverage of affected event types.
- Focused/full backend units, format, Release build, bounded Jev design and immutable-head preflight, adversarial review, final-head CI, squash merge and readback.

Stopping point: CORE-01 persistence safety delivered and source-backed coverage recorded; the structural content splits remain in their owning later families.
state.earlyGuard: All fourteen statically-base guards now call DomainEventPayload.Size selecting Core generated metadata by runtime event type; audited oversized nominal guards now use 48KiB payload margin. Exact envelope preflight remains authoritative.

validation.red: Oversized admissible incident accepted; oversized later batch and KV insert/put accepted before implementation.
validation.focused: 34 passed: exact boundary/one-over, real envelope/pinned SDK encoding, Unicode route/key, large actor through actual SaveAsync, before-session serializer failure, notices, aliases, metadata coverage, cancellation and failure mapping.
validation.coverage: All 81 IDs and source hashes unchanged; CORE-01 awaiting merged readback; every other observation remains pending.

state.explicitLimits: Same registered deterministic generated serializer is used in preflight and delegated Fitz append. No owner/content split, retained-state or physical-replay correction is claimed. KV errors remain infrastructure failures. No deployment/reset.
state.decision: Prefer actual storage safety while preserving authorization and unknown outcomes. Review output is advisory; hosted final-head CI still required.
